source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 16 (Lab safety aur practical skills) ki exercise hal ke saath (PDF 348-349): MCQs ke jawab aur wajah, short aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab, Kitab ki ghalti aur Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 16 (Lab safety aur practical skills) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) diye gaye hain. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi. Kai sawal (indicators, confirmatory tests) chapter se aage ke hain; un ke jawab par "chapter se aage" likha hai.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)
Q.1 Har sawal ke chaar jawab diye gaye hain. Sahi jawab chunein.

blocks.prompt:
I. While taking a reading with a burette, why it is always advisable to read the lower meniscus for the colorless liquids and the upper meniscus for the coloured liquids?
(Burette ki reading lete waqt be-rang liquids ka neeche wala meniscus aur rangeen liquids ka oopar wala meniscus parhne ka mashwara kyun diya jata hai?)

options.text: Kyun ke be-rang liquids ki surface tension rangeen se zyada hai
Kyun ke rangeen liquids ka neeche wala meniscus hota hi nahi

blocks.explanation: Gehre rangeen liquid (maslan KMnO₄ ka mehlool) mein neeche wala meniscus liquid ke aar paar nazar nahi aata, is liye saaf nazar aane wala oopar ka meniscus parhte hain; be-rang liquid mein neeche wala saaf dikhta hai (chapter se aage). Parallax (d) se bachne ke liye aankh meniscus ki seedh mein rakhte hain, jo bhi meniscus parha jaye.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Option (c) ki ibarat theek nahi: rangeen liquid ka neeche wala meniscus hota hai, magar liquid ke aar paar nazar nahi aata. Muraad wala jawab (c) hi hai.

blocks.prompt:
II. Why phenolphthalein indicator is more appropriate to use during the titrations which involve a strong acid and a strong base?
(Strong acid aur strong base ki titration mein phenolphthalein indicator zyada munasib kyun hai?)

options.text: Kyun ke yeh khud halka acidic hai
Kyun ke equivalence point ka pH aur phenolphthalein ke rang badalne ka pH aapas mein milte hain
Kyun ke titration ke aakhir mein mehlool acidic hota hai
Kyun ke titration ke aakhir mein mehlool basic hota hai

blocks.explanation: Indicator tab munasib hai jab us ke rang badalne ki range equivalence point par pH ki tez chhalang ke andar ho. Strong acid–strong base mein pH 7 ke ird gird tezi se (taqreeban 3 se 11) badalta hai, jis mein phenolphthalein ki range (taqreeban 8 se 10) aa jati hai, is liye ek qatra rang badal deta hai (chapter se aage).

blocks.prompt:
III. Which cation gives a white gelatinous precipitate upon the addition of aqueous ammonia?
(Aqueous ammonia dalne par kaun sa cation safed gelatinous (jelly jaisa) precipitate deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Al³⁺ se Al(OH)₃ ka safed gelatinous precipitate banta hai jo zyada ammonia mein hal nahi hota (16.7a). Cr³⁺ sabz precipitate deta hai; Zn²⁺ ka safed precipitate zyada ammonia mein hal ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
IV. Addition of NH₄OH to an aqueous solution of a cation gives a green precipitate which turns brown upon standing. Which basic radical is indicated?
(Kisi cation ke mehlool mein NH₄OH dalne se sabz precipitate banta hai jo rakhne par bhoora ho jata hai. Kaun sa basic radical hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fe²⁺ se Fe(OH)₂ banta hai jo hawa se jaldi oxidize ho kar orange-bhoora Fe(OH)₃ ban jata hai (16.7f). Fe³⁺ foran bhoora precipitate deta hai; Cr³⁺ ka sabz precipitate sabz hi rehta hai; Cu²⁺ ka neela.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Chapter mein NaOH ke saath Fe²⁺ ka sabz precipitate likha hai, aur ammonia ke saath "white gelatinous" Fe(OH)₂ jo jaldi bhoora ho jata hai. Dono soorton mein pehchan yahi hai: pehle halka (sabz) precipitate, phir hawa se bhoora.

blocks.prompt:
V. On dry heating test for salt analysis, the evolution of a colorless, odorless gas that turns limewater milky suggests the presence of:
(Salt analysis ke dry heating test mein be-rang, be-boo gas jo lime water ko doodhiya kar de, kis ki maujoodgi batati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh gas CO₂ hai: lime water ko doodhiya karti hai, Ca(OH)₂ + CO₂ → CaCO₃(s) + H₂O (16.6a). Kai carbonates garam karne par CO₂ dete hain, maslan CaCO₃ → CaO + CO₂ (chapter se aage); nitrates is ki jagah bhoori NO₂ dete hain.

blocks.prompt:
VI. The chromyl chloride test is a specific confirmatory test for:
(Chromyl chloride test kis ka khaas confirmatory test hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chloride ko K₂Cr₂O₇ aur conc. H₂SO₄ ke saath garam karne se chromyl chloride, CrO₂Cl₂, ke orange-laal bukharat bante hain; bromides aur iodides aisa compound nahi banate (chapter se aage).

blocks.prompt:
VII. The brown ring test is a confirmatory test for which acid radical?
(Brown ring test kis acid radical ka confirmatory test hai?)
blocks.explanation: Taaza FeSO₄ mehlool ke saath aur conc. H₂SO₄ test tube ki deewar se dalne par nitrate dono tahon ke milap par [Fe(H₂O)₅NO]²⁺ ka bhoora chhalla (brown ring) banata hai (chapter se aage).

blocks.text: Short Answer Questions (mukhtasar jawab wale sawal)
Q.2 Neeche diye gaye mukhtasar sawalon ke jawab dein:

blocks.prompt:
a. For which type of titration, methyl orange is used as an indicator?
Methyl orange kis qisam ki titration mein indicator ke tor par istemal hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Methyl orange (rang taqreeban pH 3.1–4.4 par laal se peela) strong acid aur weak base ki titration mein istemal hota hai, maslan HCl aur NH₃(aq) ya Na₂CO₃, jahan equivalence point acidic hota hai. Strong acid–strong base mein bhi chal jata hai (chapter se aage).

blocks.prompt:
b. Explain why phenolphthalein is a suitable indicator for the titration of a weak acid with a strong base but not for the titration of a strong acid with a weak base.
Wazeh karein ke phenolphthalein weak acid–strong base titration ke liye munasib kyun hai magar strong acid–weak base ke liye kyun nahi.
blocks.explanation:
Phenolphthalein taqreeban pH 8–10 par rang badalta hai.
Weak acid + strong base: banne wala salt basic hai, is liye equivalence point 7 se oopar (taqreeban 8–9), isi range mein; rang tezi se badalta hai.
Strong acid + weak base: salt acidic hai, equivalence point 7 se neeche (taqreeban 5); phenolphthalein us se bohat pehle ya baad rang badlega, ghalat end point. Is ki jagah methyl orange lete hain (chapter se aage).

blocks.prompt:
c. Explain why different indicators change color over different pH ranges.
Wazeh karein ke mukhtalif indicators mukhtalif pH ranges par rang kyun badalte hain.
blocks.explanation: Indicator ek weak organic acid (ya base) hai, HIn ⇌ H⁺ + In⁻, jis ki un-ionized shakal aur ion ke rang mukhtalif hain. Rang tab badalta hai jab dono shaklein taqreeban barabar hon, yani indicator ke pKₐ ke qareeb (taqreeban pKₐ ± 1). Har indicator ka apna Kₐ hai, is liye har ek apni pH range par rang badalta hai, maslan methyl orange 3.1–4.4, phenolphthalein taqreeban 8–10 (chapter se aage).

blocks.prompt:
d. It is always advisable to use dilute solutions while performing experiments in volumetric analysis? Give a reason.
Volumetric analysis ke tajurbaat mein hamesha dilute mehlool istemal karne ka mashwara kyun diya jata hai? Wajah bataein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Durustgi: dilute mehlool mein zyada aur aasani se naapa jane wala volume lagta hai, is liye reading ki ghalti (taqreeban ±0.05 cm³) ka percentage kam hota hai, aur ek faltu qatra end point se aage nahi le jata.
2. Hifazat: dilute acids aur bases kam corrosive hain aur milane par kam garmi dete hain (chapter se aage).

blocks.prompt:
e. White precipitates are formed when Ca²⁺, Al³⁺ and Zn²⁺ all react separately with NaOH solution. How will you detect which basic radical is present?
Ca²⁺, Al³⁺ aur Zn²⁺ teeno NaOH ke saath alag alag safed precipitate dete hain. Kaun sa basic radical hai, kaise pehchanenge?
blocks.explanation:
Zyada NaOH dalein, phir naye hisse mein aqueous ammonia (zyada miqdar tak) dalein:
Ca²⁺: precipitate zyada NaOH mein hal nahi hota; NH₃ se sirf halki dhundlahat ya koi precipitate nahi.
Al³⁺: precipitate zyada NaOH mein hal ho jata hai (chapter se aage); NH₃ se safed gelatinous precipitate jo zyada NH₃ mein hal nahi.
Zn²⁺: precipitate zyada NaOH mein hal; NH₃ se safed precipitate jo zyada NH₃ mein hal ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
f. How Fe²⁺ can be distinguished from Fe³⁺ chemically?
Fe²⁺ ko Fe³⁺ se chemically kaise pehchanenge?
blocks.explanation: Dono mein NaOH (ya aqueous ammonia) ka mehlool dalein.

rows: Rakhne par orange-bhoora ho jata hai (hawa se oxidize)

blocks.prompt:
g. Why Ca²⁺ does not give precipitate with aqueous ammonia?
Ca²⁺ aqueous ammonia ke saath precipitate kyun nahi deta?
blocks.explanation: Aqueous ammonia weak base hai: NH₃ + H₂O ⇌ NH₄⁺ + OH⁻ sirf thori OH⁻ deta hai. Ca(OH)₂ kafi had tak hal hota hai, is liye itni kam OH⁻ use precipitate nahi kar sakti; zyada se zyada halki dhundlahat aati hai (16.7c). Strong NaOH kafi OH⁻ deta hai jis se Ca(OH)₂ precipitate ho jata hai (wajah chapter se aage).

blocks.prompt:
h. How will you find out the concentration of acetic acid in vinegar solution?
Sirke (vinegar) mein acetic acid ki concentration kaise maloom karenge?
blocks.explanation:
Standard NaOH ke saath acid-base titration se (tareeqa 16.5 jaisa):
1. Sirke ki naapi hui miqdar ko distilled paani se patla karein (maslan 10 guna) aur maloom volume (maslan 10 cm³) pipette se conical flask mein lein.
2. Phenolphthalein ke 1–2 qatre dalein (weak acid–strong base).
3. Burette se standard NaOH dalein jab tak halka gulabi rang qaim na rahe; concordant readings lein.
CH₃COOH(aq) + NaOH(aq) → CH₃COONa(aq) + H₂O(l)
4. M₁V₁/n₁ (acid) = M₂V₂/n₂ (base), n₁ = n₂ = 1, se patle acid ki molarity; is ko dilution factor se zarb dein. g dm⁻³ mein concentration = molarity × 60 g mol⁻¹ (CH₃COOH ka molar mass).

blocks.prompt:
i. What precautions you need to observe while diluting a concentrated acid?
Concentrated acid ko patla karte waqt kaun si ehtiyatein zaroori hain?
blocks.explanation:
1. Hamesha acid ko paani mein dalein, ahista aur thora thora, musalsal hilate hue; concentrated acid mein kabhi paani na dalein (paida hone wali garmi paani ko ubal kar acid ke chheente uda sakti hai).
2. Garmi bardasht karne wala glass beaker lein, zaroorat ho to thande paani mein rakhein.
3. Lab coat, safety goggles aur gloves pehnein; fume cupboard mein kaam karein; akele kaam na karein (16.1).
(Tafseel chapter se aage.)

blocks.prompt:
j. Why does an aqueous solution of Na₂CO₃ behave like a base?
Na₂CO₃ ka aqueous mehlool base ki tarah kyun bartao karta hai?
blocks.explanation:
Na₂CO₃ strong base (NaOH) aur weak acid (H₂CO₃) ka salt hai. Paani mein carbonate ion hydrolysis kar ke OH⁻ ions banata hai:
CO₃²⁻(aq) + H₂O(l) ⇌ HCO₃⁻(aq) + OH⁻(aq)
Zaid OH⁻ mehlool ko basic (pH 7 se zyada) bana deti hai (chapter se aage).

blocks.prompt:
k. If an aqueous solution of NaOH is kept in an open container, what changes do you expect to take place with the passage of time?
Agar NaOH ka aqueous mehlool khule bartan mein rakha jaye to waqt ke saath kya tabdeeliyan hongi?
blocks.explanation:
NaOH hawa se carbon dioxide jazb kar ke ahista ahista sodium carbonate ban jata hai:
2NaOH(aq) + CO₂(g) → Na₂CO₃(aq) + H₂O(l)
Is liye NaOH ki concentration kam ho jati hai aur mehlool ki likhi hui molarity nahi rehti; titration ke nataij ghalat aate hain (chapter batata hai ke hawa ki CO₂ phenolphthalein ke end point mein khalal dalti hai). Paani ure to concentration bhi badalti hai.

blocks.prompt:
Q.3 Describe common types of the Chemistry lab hazards with two examples in each case.
Chemistry lab ke aam khatron ki qismein, har ek ki do misalon ke saath, bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Lab ke zyada tar khatre teen qismon mein hain: physical, chemical aur biological.
1. Physical khatre: mahol aur aalaat se khatre.
Misalein: (i) geele farsh par phisalna aur girna; (ii) tootay glass ke bartanon se kat aur kharash.
Ehtiyat: farsh khushk rakhein; toota glass uthate waqt cut-resistant gloves pehnein aur use khaas dabbe mein dalein.
2. Chemical khatre: khud chemicals se khatre (corrosive, zehreele ya aag pakarne wale).
Misalein: (i) concentrated acids aur alkalis (maslan H₂SO₄, NaOH) ya bromine se jalna; (ii) spirit ya tel jaise aag pakarne wale liquids se aag, ya chemicals nigalne se zehr (maslan heavy metals ke namak).
Ehtiyat: chemicals standard tareeqe se istemal karein; kabhi chakhein ya soonghein nahi; lab coat aur goggles pehnein; kachra theek rakhein aur label karein.
3. Biological khatre: jandaron aur un ki paidawar se khatre.
Misalein: (i) allergens (allergy karne wali cheezein); (ii) janwaron se insanon mein aane wali chhoot ki bimariyan, aur viral bimariyan.
Ehtiyat: lab mein khana nahi; gloves pehnein; warning signs par amal karein.

rows: Geele farsh par phisalna; tootay glass se katna
Concentrated acids, alkalis ya bromine se jalna; aag pakarne wale liquids se aag (ya zehr)
Allergens; janwaron se insanon mein chhoot ki bimariyan (aur viral bimariyan)

blocks.prompt:
Q.4 What are common accidents in the Chemistry lab? How they are managed in first aid treatment.
Chemistry lab ke aam hadsaat kya hain? First aid mein inhein kaise sambhala jata hai?
blocks.explanation:
Har lab mein first aid box hona chahiye. Aam hadsaat aur first aid (Table 16.1):
1. Katna: chhota zakhm: glass ka tukra nikalein aur rooi se methylated spirit ya tincture iodine lagayein (jaraseem kush). Gehra zakhm: khoon rokne ke liye taqreeban 10 minute dabayein aur doctor ko dikhayein.
2. Aankh ki choten: aankh mein acid: khoob paani se dhoyein, phir 1% sodium bicarbonate mehlool. Alkali: paani, phir 1% boric acid mehlool. Koi zarra: aankh na malein; naram rumaal se ahista nikal kar paani se dhoyein. Dard/jalan: zaitoon ke tel ka ek qatra dal kar aankhein kuch der band rakhein.
3. Jalna: khushk garmi (shola, garam cheez): burnol ya sarson ka tel. Acid se jalna: barf jaise thande paani se dhoyein, phir saturated sodium bicarbonate, phir paani. Alkali se jalna: paani, phir 1% acetic acid, phir paani; sukha kar burnol. Bromine se jalna: 2% ammonia mehlool se dhoyein aur glycerin lagayein, baad mein pooch kar burnol.
4. Zehr: zehr nigal liya: foran thookein aur baar baar kulli karein. Acid nigla: bohat paani, lime water ya milk of magnesia piyein. Caustic alkali nigla: bohat paani aur leemu ya maalte ka ras. Heavy metals ke namak: doodh ya ande ki safedi.
5. Aag: kapron ko aag: bhaagein nahi; kambal ya khushk sooti kapre mein lipat kar farsh par let jayein. Beaker mein aag pakarne wale liquid ko aag: geela kapra dhak kar oxygen band karein. Spirit ya tel ki aag: ret aur sodium bicarbonate ka mixture dalein, paani nahi (paani aag phailata hai). Bijli ki aag: supply band karein aur ret dalein, paani kabhi nahi.
Har hadsa foran lab in-charge ko batayein.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ki Table 16.1 mein jalne ki paanch qismein hain magar ilaaj chaar chhape hain. Yaad rakhein: acid ko halka base (sodium bicarbonate) aur alkali ko halka acid (acetic acid) neutralize karta hai. Chhaalon (blisters) wale jalne ka alag ilaaj kitab mein nahi chhapa; chhaale na phoren, thande paani se thanda kar ke saaf patti karein (chapter se aage).

blocks.prompt:
Q.5 How the following acid radicals are indicated and confirmed in salt analysis:
i) CO₃²⁻ ii) Cl⁻ iii) NO₃⁻ iv) SO₄²⁻
Salt analysis mein in acid radicals ki nishandahi aur tasdeeq kaise hoti hai: i) CO₃²⁻ ii) Cl⁻ iii) NO₃⁻ iv) SO₄²⁻
blocks.explanation:
(Nishandahi ke tests chapter (16.6) se hain; tasdeeq ke tests chapter se aage hain.)
i) Carbonate, CO₃²⁻
Nishandahi: taqreeban 2 g salt + 5 cm³ dilute HCl: tez jhaag (effervescence); gas lime water ko doodhiya karti hai.
CO₃²⁻(aq) + 2H⁺(aq) → H₂O(l) + CO₂(g)
Ca(OH)₂(aq) + CO₂(g) → CaCO₃(s) + H₂O(l)
Tasdeeq: salt ke mehlool + MgSO₄ mehlool thande mein MgCO₃ ka safed precipitate deta hai (bicarbonate sirf ubalne par).
ii) Chloride, Cl⁻
Nishandahi: dilute HNO₃ se acidic kiya salt ka mehlool + AgNO₃(aq): AgCl ka gaarha safed precipitate, jo aqueous NH₃ mein hal hai.
Ag⁺(aq) + Cl⁻(aq) → AgCl(s)
Tasdeeq (chromyl chloride test): thos salt ko thos K₂Cr₂O₇ aur conc. H₂SO₄ ke saath garam karein: CrO₂Cl₂ ke orange-laal bukharat. NaOH mein guzarne se peela mehlool, jo acetic acid aur lead acetate ke saath PbCrO₄ ka peela precipitate deta hai.
Cr₂O₇²⁻ + 4Cl⁻ + 6H⁺ → 2CrO₂Cl₂ + 3H₂O
CrO₂Cl₂ + 4NaOH → Na₂CrO₄ + 2NaCl + 2H₂O
iii) Nitrate, NO₃⁻
Nishandahi: salt ka mehlool + NaOH + aluminium powder, halka garam: NH₃ gas ki boo, jo geele laal litmus ko neela karti hai. Aluminium reducing agent hai.
3NO₃⁻(aq) + 8Al(s) + 5OH⁻(aq) + 18H₂O(l) → 3NH₃(g) + 8[Al(OH)₄]⁻(aq)
Tasdeeq (brown ring test): salt ke mehlool mein taaza FeSO₄ mehlool dalein, phir conc. H₂SO₄ test tube ki deewar se ahista dalein: dono tahon ke milap par bhoora chhalla.
NO₃⁻ + 3Fe²⁺ + 4H⁺ → NO + 3Fe³⁺ + 2H₂O
[Fe(H₂O)₆]²⁺ + NO → [Fe(H₂O)₅NO]²⁺ (bhoora) + H₂O
iv) Sulphate, SO₄²⁻
Nishandahi: dilute HNO₃ se acidic kiya salt ka mehlool + barium nitrate: BaSO₄ ka bhaari safed precipitate (acid carbonate ko hata deta hai).
SO₄²⁻(aq) + Ba²⁺(aq) → BaSO₄(s)
Tasdeeq: precipitate concentrated HCl ya HNO₃ mein bhi hal nahi hota; lead acetate se PbSO₄ ka safed precipitate banta hai jo ammonium acetate mein hal ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Chapter kehta hai ke nitrate test mein aluminium "cathode" hai; yeh ghalat hai. Aluminium sirf reducing agent hai: khud oxidize ho kar [Al(OH)₄]⁻ banta aur nitrate ko ammonia tak reduce karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
Q.6 How the following basic radicals are indicated and confirmed in salt analysis:
i) Cu²⁺ ii) Al³⁺ iii) Fe³⁺ iv) Zn²⁺
Salt analysis mein in basic radicals ki nishandahi aur tasdeeq kaise hoti hai: i) Cu²⁺ ii) Al³⁺ iii) Fe³⁺ iv) Zn²⁺
blocks.explanation:
(Taqreeban 4 g salt 10 cm³ distilled paani mein hal kar ke hisson mein baant lein. NaOH aur NH₃ wale tests chapter (16.7) se hain; tasdeeq ke tests aur zyada reagent mein reactions chapter se aage hain.)
i) Copper, Cu²⁺
Nishandahi: NaOH se Cu(OH)₂ ka halka neela precipitate.
Cu²⁺(aq) + 2OH⁻(aq) → Cu(OH)₂(s)
Aqueous NH₃: thora dalne se halka neela precipitate; zyada mein hal ho kar gehra neela mehlool.
Cu(OH)₂(s) + 4NH₃(aq) → [Cu(NH₃)₄]²⁺(aq) + 2OH⁻(aq)
Tasdeeq: potassium ferrocyanide, K₄[Fe(CN)₆], se Cu₂[Fe(CN)₆] ka chocolate-bhoora precipitate.
ii) Aluminium, Al³⁺
Nishandahi: NaOH se Al(OH)₃ ka safed gelatinous precipitate, jo zyada NaOH mein hal ho jata hai; aqueous NH₃ se safed precipitate jo zyada mein hal nahi.
Al³⁺(aq) + 3OH⁻(aq) → Al(OH)₃(s)
Al(OH)₃(s) + OH⁻(aq) → [Al(OH)₄]⁻(aq)
Tasdeeq (lake test): salt ke mehlool mein neele litmus ke do qatre, phir NH₄OH qatra qatra: neela precipitate ('lake', yani rang jazb kiya hua Al(OH)₃) be-rang mehlool mein tairta hai.
iii) Iron(III), Fe³⁺
Nishandahi: NaOH ya aqueous NH₃ se foran Fe(OH)₃ ka orange-bhoora precipitate.
Fe³⁺(aq) + 3OH⁻(aq) → Fe(OH)₃(s)
Tasdeeq: K₄[Fe(CN)₆] se gehra (Prussian) neela precipitate, aur potassium thiocyanate, KSCN, se khoon jaisa laal rang.
4Fe³⁺ + 3[Fe(CN)₆]⁴⁻ → Fe₄[Fe(CN)₆]₃
Fe³⁺ + SCN⁻ → [Fe(SCN)]²⁺
iv) Zinc, Zn²⁺
Nishandahi: NaOH se Zn(OH)₂ ka safed precipitate, zyada NaOH mein hal; aqueous NH₃ se safed precipitate, zyada NH₃ mein hal.
Zn²⁺(aq) + 2OH⁻(aq) → Zn(OH)₂(s)
Zn(OH)₂(s) + 2OH⁻(aq) → [Zn(OH)₄]²⁻(aq)
Zn(OH)₂(s) + 4NH₃(aq) → [Zn(NH₃)₄]²⁺(aq) + 2OH⁻(aq)
Tasdeeq: K₄[Fe(CN)₆] se safed (neela-safed) precipitate.
